s1.desc: a bedroom drawn on a plain pale grey background, with a big yellow bed with duck-topped bedposts

beats.text: Pax and Polly sit side by side in bed and touch beaks in a kiss as a little heart pops up between them
Pax and Polly lean apart, smiling with their eyes closed

spans.notes: Both leads are cut by the frame edges (Pax left, Polly right). Static: compare 0/24 (headboard and pillow edges black).

spans.view: with a wall air conditioner above the bed, a desk fan on the left nightstand and blankets on the bed

beats.text: Pax and Polly sit side by side against the pillows, opening their eyes and gazing ahead
Pax straightens up tall and closes his eyes while Polly grabs the top edge of the blanket
Polly pulls one blanket after another up to her chin while Pax sits beside her with his eyes closed
Polly tugs the yellow hood up over her head
Polly turns toward the right side of the bed and opens her eyes wide while Pax sits still with his eyes closed

spans.notes: Static f25-f113 (compare 25/113; bed-region phase shift 0 to f113). A fast push-in onto Polly starts at f114. | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_1): Beat 104-114 says Polly 'rolls onto her side to sleep', but at f108-113 she turns toward the right side of the bed and her eyes pop open wide (alert, not sleeping).; Beat 25-38 says Polly 'lies back against her pillow': she is already sitting against the pillows and only turns from facing Pax (eyes closed f25-26) to facing ahead with her eyes open; Pax straightens up at f37-38 and keeps his eyes c
Fast push-in from the wide two-shot to Polly; static again from f120 (bedpost region identical f120-f153).

spans.view: with a small heater on the nightstand beside her

beats.text: Polly, tucked under the blankets with her hood up, reaches over and switches on the small heater
Polly settles back with her eyes closed and a cozy smile as the heater glows orange

spans.view: with a desk fan and a remote on the nightstand beside him

beats.text: Pax sits up in bed with his eyes closed, panting with his beak open as sweat drops form on his face
Pax opens his eyes and turns toward the desk fan on the nightstand
Pax switches the fan on and its blades start spinning
Pax faces the breeze with his eyes closed in relief
Pax reaches over and picks up the remote from the nightstand
Pax holds the remote up and points it ahead, looking up with a worried frown

spans.notes: Static: compare 154/288. Ends at f288: a whip tilt up to the air conditioner starts at f289. | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_1): Beat 274-289 says Pax 'jabs its buttons': the remote and flipper are frozen f272-288 (identical positions); Pax only holds it up pointing ahead/up with worried eyes and a moving beak.
Whip tilt up from Pax to the wall air conditioner (picture slides down f289-292, the unit settles f293-296).
Insert: the air conditioner alone, its temperature readout dropping, frost, snow and icicles growing on it. No lead.

spans.view: with a desk fan and a remote on the nightstand and a rope hanging down beside the bed

beats.text: Pax sits in bed with his head turned to the left and his eyes shut
Pax turns to face ahead and opens his eyes with a worried frown
Pax reaches out and grabs a rope hanging beside the bed
Pax pulls the rope down, holding it in his flipper

spans.notes: Static: compare 339/377. | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_1): Beat 339-352 omits that Pax's eyes are shut and his head is turned to the left f339-343; he turns to face ahead and opens worried eyes only at f344.

spans.view: with a frosted air conditioner dripping icicles above the bed, a desk fan and a glowing heater on the nightstands

beats.text: Pax lets go of a rope hanging above the bed and it slides back up out of view while Polly sleeps beside a glowing heater
Pax sits back with his flippers relaxed and his eyes closed, smiling calmly, while Polly sleeps on
Pax disappears under a stream of ice cubes pouring down from above
Pax sits buried in a mound of ice cubes with only his face showing, eyes closed and content, while Polly sleeps on
